name: presenter-garage
description: Read a ProPresenter 7 library and edit its slide text: search, read presentations and playlists, read the configured groups and macros, run text checks, audit the media bin, preview themes, write songs, checks and comparisons to a folder, and change lines once you confirm them.
long_description: Reads ProPresenter 7 files from disk, through the same decoding and checks as the Presenter Garage browser app. List and search presentations, read their slides line by line with each slide's group and macros, read ProPresenter's configured groups and macros, run the Presentations text checks, read or audit the media bin, read the presentation playlists, and list themes and preview giving a presentation one of their looks. It can also edit slide text: you are shown every line as it is and as it would read, and can untick any, before anything is written; each file is backed up outside your library first. The tools that write out a whole library, check it or compare it with another put the songs in a new folder inside one you name, never inside, nor holding, a library the call reads, and never over a file, and answer only with counts and paths, so the lyrics stay on your computer. Turn on Read only and it never writes a file. It works in one library at a time, the folder you choose, and opens another, or reads a second one to compare, only once you approve.

library_folder.title: ProPresenter folder
library_folder.description: The folder holding your Libraries and Playlists, usually Documents/ProPresenter. From ProPresenter 22 it is a workspace folder instead, under Library/Application Support/RenewedVision/ProPresenter/Workspaces, whose slide text is edited only while ProPresenter is closed. One library is read at a time: Claude can open another only once you approve it.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Never write a file. The tools that edit slide text, save the rules or write results to a folder are then not offered; check_presentations stays, answering with its findings.

allow_cloud_workspace.title: Cloud workspace to write to (experiment)
allow_cloud_workspace.description: Leave empty. Only for the experiments of https://github.com/eugenius1/presenter-garage/issues/55: the uuid of one ProPresenter Cloud workspace, its folder's name, whose slide text may then be edited. Another computer's change to the same text box can replace an edit made here at the next sync.

tools.name: list_presentations
tools.description: List presentation files, by name or by when they were last shown.

tools.name: current_library
tools.description: Say which library is open, whether it can be edited, and what to know before trusting it.

tools.name: use_library
tools.description: Open another ProPresenter library in place of this one, once you approve the switch.

tools.name: read_presentation
tools.description: Read a presentation's slides line by line, with each slide's group and macros, and its dates, notes, CCLI details and arrangements.

tools.name: read_groups_and_macros
tools.description: Read ProPresenter's configured groups and macros, with names exactly as stored.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find a phrase in the slide text of every presentation.

tools.name: check_presentations
tools.description: Run the team's rules, or the text checks, on a file, a folder or every library, answering with the findings or writing them to a folder.

tools.name: check_rules
tools.description: Load the team's rules as the checks run them, write them to a folder, and say whether they are out of date.

tools.name: find_libraries
tools.description: Find the ProPresenter libraries and workspaces on this computer, and write the list to a folder.

tools.name: dump_library
tools.description: Write every song in the library to a folder, as JSON and as text, answering only with counts and paths.

tools.name: compare_libraries
tools.description: Compare the library with another, once you approve reading it, and write a side-by-side report to a folder.

tools.name: read_rules
tools.description: Read the team's RULES.md and the rules.json compiled from it, with every check a rule can use.

tools.name: save_rules
tools.description: Check and save the team's rules, compiled from RULES.md, as rules.json beside it.

tools.name: read_media_bin
tools.description: Read every playlist in the media bin and the items in it.

tools.name: audit_media_bin
tools.description: Find duplicates, empty playlists, hidden items and other media bin problems.

tools.name: read_playlists
tools.description: Read the presentation playlists: every service and the songs, headers and media in it.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the themes and the slide styles each offers.

tools.name: preview_style
tools.description: Preview giving a presentation the look of a theme slide or another slide, without changing it.

tools.name: plan_slide_edits
tools.description: Work out changes to slides without writing anything: lines changed, removed or added, a group renamed, a macro swapped for another.

tools.name: apply_slide_edits
tools.description: Apply planned slide changes once you confirm each one, backing up every file first.
